title: 第11章 钱包还没捂热三秒就花出去了
novel_title: 我在星际召唤古人，带飞华夏文明
content_zh:
“这...这是何物！”

    荣华后退一步，靠在种植区的栏杆上，望着站起来和小侄儿一样高的大松鼠瑟瑟发抖。

    “别担心，这是你的同事，也是古城的另一个员工。”

    花期双手插在松鼠的胳肢窝里，将它举起来对着荣华介绍，“它叫松松，负责摘树上的水果，你们以后会天天在一起工作。”

    松鼠嘴里还嚼着一粒花期投喂的花生米，视线骤然拔高，它抬起尾巴，友好地向荣华打了招呼。。

    “吱。”你好啊两脚兽，俺叫松松。

    “松..松松？”

    荣华看着松松背后的大尾巴，又望着一脸笑意的花期，心头的惊慌渐渐被压下。

    她松开手，摆正身体，对着松松曲了下腿，“妾身荣华，见过松...”

    她顿了一下，余光偷瞄松鼠的下身，不知道这是公松鼠还是母松鼠。

    花期揉了下松鼠的大脑门，想起合同上松鼠的性别，道：“它比你年龄小，是妹妹。”

    荣华松口气，继续把没行完的礼行完，“见过松妹妹，一同供职，还望多多照拂。”

    松松听不懂荣华在说什么，经花期翻译后，它咧开嘴，憨笑地甩了甩大尾巴。

    “吱吱。”两脚兽姐姐，不用客气，俺会好好工作的。

    花期再次当同声翻译，“松松让你别客气。”

    荣华点点头再次欠了欠身，便站在芒果树下躲避阳光。

    “坐啊，别拘谨。”

    花期放下体格庞大的松松，随意地摘了三个芒果招呼大家坐在树下。

    松松跟着靠在她身边，接过大芒果吱吱叫了两声，便用大板牙撕开芒果表皮。

    荣华停顿了一秒，才犹豫地坐在花期身后。

    她拿到了芒果也不敢吃，塞进衣袖中，准备今天晚上带回去。

    花期没管她，把早上在城主府熬制的花茶给一人倒了一杯，随即打开个人终端浏览拼夕夕。

    城主府内缺很多东西，况且现在还是两个员工，每天的饭菜靠着秒杀外卖也不现实。

    毕竟她不是每次都会这么好运。

    她得买点米面粮油自己做饭，这一点能节省很多。

    蔬菜也能种，种植区的速度今天种下明天就能吃，不用担心没蔬菜。
content_en:
"This...what is this!"

    Ronghua took a step back and leaned on the railing of the planting area, looking at the big squirrel that stood as tall as his nephew and shivering.

    "Don't worry, this is your colleague and another employee of the ancient city."

    Hua Qi put her hands in the squirrel's armpits, raised it up and introduced it to Rong Hua, "Its name is Song Song, and it is responsible for picking fruits from the tree. You will work together every day in the future."

    The squirrel was still chewing a peanut that was fed during the flowering period, and its eyes suddenly raised. It raised its tail and greeted Ronghua in a friendly manner. .

    "Squeak." Hello Twolegs, my name is Songsong.

    "Song...Songsong?"

    Ronghua looked at the big tail behind Songsong, and then at Huaqi with a smile on his face, and the panic in his heart was gradually suppressed.

    She let go of her hands, straightened her body, and bent her legs towards Songsong, "I have a glorious body, I have seen Songsong..."

    She paused and peeked at the squirrel's lower body from the corner of her eye, wondering whether it was a male or female squirrel.

    Hua Qi rubbed the squirrel's forehead, remembered the squirrel's gender in the contract, and said, "She is younger than you, she is your sister."

    Rong Hua breathed a sigh of relief and continued to finish the unfinished ceremony, "I have met Sister Song and worked together. I hope you will take care of her."

    Songsong couldn't understand what Ronghua was talking about. After Huaqi translated it, he grinned and flicked his big tail with a silly smile.

    "Zhizhi." Sister Twoleg, you're welcome, I will work hard.

    Huaqi once again acted as simultaneous translator, "Songsong asked you to be welcome."

    Ronghua nodded and bowed again, then stood under the mango tree to avoid the sun.

    "Sit down, don't be shy."

    During the flower period, he put down the huge Songsong, randomly picked three mangoes and invited everyone to sit under the tree.

    Songsong followed and leaned next to her, took the big mango, squeaked twice, and then used his big teeth to tear open the mango's skin.

    Ronghua paused for a second before hesitantly sitting behind Huaqi.

    She didn't dare to eat the mangoes after she got them, so she stuffed them into her sleeves and planned to take them back tonight.

    Huaqi ignored her and poured each of them a cup of the scented tea brewed in the City Lord's Mansion in the morning, then opened his personal terminal to browse Pinxixi.

    There are a lot of things missing in the City Lord's Mansion, and besides, there are still only two employees, so it is unrealistic to rely on instant takeout for daily meals.

    After all, she is not always so lucky.

    She has to buy some rice, flour, grain and oil to cook herself, which can save a lot.

    Vegetables can also be grown. The speed in the planting area allows you to plant them today and eat them tomorrow, so you don’t have to worry about running out of vegetables.
title_en: Chapter 11 I spent three seconds before my wallet was warmed.
